annotations.title: Make a photo collage (heart, number, word...)

description: Builds a photo collage in the shape of a heart, a number (age, anniversary, year), a word, a star, a flower and more from the user's photos, and returns a watermarked preview within seconds. Use when the user asks for a heart collage, a birthday/anniversary number collage, a 'photo collage in the shape of ...', or a collage from several photos. Pass the photos as public links in photo_urls, or as files the user attached (photos). 1 to 300 photos; if there are fewer photos than cells, photos repeat. The result id (clg_...) is a private handle valid for 30 days; photos and results are deleted after 30 days. The preview is watermarked; the full-resolution file is downloaded from the collager.ai page given in full_resolution_page. Building can take up to a minute - if status is still processing, call get_shape_collage with the id.

background.description: Background colour: white (default), cream, pink, black or #rrggbb.

gap_pct.description: White gap between photos, % of a cell (default 6).

photo_urls.description: Public http(s) links to the photos (JPEG/PNG/WEBP).

photos.description: Photos the user attached in the chat.

shape.description: The figure. Examples: {"type":"heart"} (size picked from the photo count), {"type":"heart","cells":70}, {"type":"number","text":"30"}, {"type":"text","text":"LOVE"}, {"type":"love"} ("I love you"), {"type":"star","size":"large"}, {"type":"grid","n":4}. Call list_collage_shapes for all options.

cells.description: Heart only: number of photo cells.

size.description: number/text/circle/star/flower: how many cells (bigger = more photos).

text.description: number/text: the digits or word (Latin letters and digits).

url.description: mask_url: link to a black-and-white picture; each black pixel is one photo cell.
